observation_note: 重新研究、重新取数；各请求为读取时状态，非原子快照
subtitle: 从官方入口逐条追踪相关来源，再按相同定义核对两站。明确区分拒绝类别、已证数据机制、候选因素和仍不可见的内部触发条件。

conclusion.lead: 美国被拒的已确认类别是账户信誉、活动或政策状态；现有证据仍不能确定具体内部触发项。经营记录和公开政策中的问题值得整改，但不能直接改写为 Shopify 已确认的拒绝根因。
established: US：用户后台截图确认不合格，属于账户信誉／活动／政策综合分支。
UK：用户直接确认已合格并显示纳入数量；精确数值未知，不推断大于零。
两站 Plus 套餐及密码保护关闭已由新 API 确认；最终 Catalog 资格不是这些 API 字段的推算结果。
mechanisms: US 候选中 5,630 笔仅非配送行有待履约量；其中 4,879 笔展示部分履约且至少有一条需配送行的 API 送达记录。展示部分履约不能统一算实物欠发货。
任务关闭、订单行剩余、退款、承运人事件是不同层次；已发现关闭任务与订单行待履约量并存。
US 隐私政策广告分享表述不一致，配送时长／费用及卖方角色存在文字歧义。已证的是公开文字问题。
candidates: 被标记需配送且仍有待履约量的已付订单，需核对逐单承诺、当前工作归属和实际交付。
风险建议与后续处理应通过形成时间和人工复核记录核对；CANCEL 不自动证明欺诈或错误放行。
公开披露准确性、账户安全、账单、政策案件和支付方风险记录可能相关，具体是否触发本次拒绝尚未确认。
unknowns: 内部信誉评分、权重、数值阈值、具体拒绝触发项和自动复评时间。
账户邮箱验证、两步验证、通行密钥、核验提示、商家账单及完整内部合规案件。
第三方网关争议及适用交易分母；没有计算伪全店拒付率。
全商品最终 Catalog 分类／纳入、全部图片内容语义、所有市场最终付款流程。

cohort_note: 订单创建批次固定为 2026-07-18 00:00 至 2026-10-16 00:00（Asia/Shanghai，左闭右开）；状态为各请求读取时当前值。履约候选为独立的跨创建日期集合，不能与创建批次混作同一个分母。

comparison.meaning: UK 精确纳入数量未知；未用 publication 数量冒充。
仅窄配置条件得到支持，不替代账单、政策及最终资格。
全量 API 可见观察集合；不等于 Catalog 实际纳入数，读取非原子。

comparison.metric: 固定创建批次：非测试订单
comparison.meaning: 全量新提取并精确对账；非测试不等于客户真实性已独立认证。

comparison.metric: 该批次展示未履约／部分履约
comparison.meaning: 订单展示状态，不是实际欠发货或逾期数量。
其中 US 125、UK 1 当前展示已履约；无形成时间及动作时序，不认定欺诈或违规放行。

comparison.metric: 跨创建日期：完整履约候选
comparison.meaning: 当前工作搜索与创建批次未完成展示订单的并集；不是全部店铺订单或所有可能任务。

comparison.metric: 候选中仅非配送行有待履约量
comparison.meaning: 非配送标记不认证服务已经交付，也不自动判定保险等法律产品类型。

comparison.metric: 已付清、未取消、需配送行待履约
comparison.meaning: 同定义的待核实工作；缺逐单承诺时不判逾期，不将规模差异当因果证据。

comparison.metric: 需配送行数量与非终态 FO 工作差异
comparison.meaning: 生命周期／工作归属待解释；不把任务关闭算完成，也不直接证明未实际送达。

comparison.metric: Shopify Payments API 可见争议
comparison.meaning: 两站查询成功且分页结束；第三方网关未覆盖，实际交易分母未知。

findings.title: 修复计划纳入商品中的缺图候选
findings.fact: US 定义的已发布候选中 19 个商品未见图片对象；全 API 可见商品中共 115 个未见图片对象，包含其它状态。UK 窄图片存在性检查通过。
findings.interpretation: 是商品图片条件的观察缺口；不等于 19 个商品已被最终 Catalog 拒绝，也不是账户信誉拒绝的已证原因。
findings.remedy: 按真实销售和纳入意图核对候选，为拟纳入商品补齐真实对应图片并复查访问性；非拟纳入商品按其正常排除处理。
findings.acceptance: 拟纳入商品有真实、可访问且符合内容要求的产品图片；商品排除与店铺最终资格分别验收。
findings.evidence: 全商品图片对象存在性检查；US 媒体全清点已停止且保留部分原始观察，不称全图片语义审阅。

findings.title: 把配送工作与非配送工作分开处理
findings.fact: US 5,630 笔候选仅非配送行仍待履约；其中 4,879 笔展示部分履约且至少一条需配送行有 API 送达记录。
findings.interpretation: 这证明旧式展示状态汇总会混入不同工作；不证明服务已完成、所有实物均送达或这些记录触发拒绝。
findings.remedy: 按稳定订单行 ID 区分实物配送、服务交付、退款／取消与当前任务；核对非配送商品的实际交付方式及相应记录。
findings.acceptance: 每个剩余工作桶有真实业务解释与交付／退款／取消证据；展示状态与任务状态可追溯，不以统一改状态代替履约。
findings.evidence: 全体跨日期候选的独立父级重聚合；API 2026-04；不是 90 天全店履约率。

findings.title: 核对已付清的需配送行待办
findings.fact: US 1,403 笔、UK 9 笔候选已付清且未取消，被标记需配送的行仍有待履约量；均观察到对应非终态 FO 工作。
findings.interpretation: 是可核对的运营工作，不直接等于逾期、欠发货或 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 逐单对照原承诺、客户沟通、任务归属、承运人取件／送达及退款结果，先处理有明确到期证据的记录。
findings.acceptance: 每笔记录有负责人、真实承诺和处置证据；无明确承诺者仍标未知，不以固定 7 天制造官方 SLA。
findings.evidence: US 10,797／UK 108 候选；非原子当前状态；数量按行关联，无二次扣退款。

findings.title: 解释关闭任务与订单行数量差异
findings.fact: 需配送行待履约量与非终态 FO 剩余量不同的记录：US 21 笔、UK 19 笔；关闭任务仍可与未履约订单行并存。
findings.interpretation: 说明工作归属／生命周期需要核对；零活跃 FO 不证明完成，也不证明历史丢单或实际未交付。
findings.remedy: 核对任务关闭、替换、移动、取消、退款和订单行变更；追踪当前工作归属及必要历史记录。
findings.acceptance: 每笔差异可解释，或明确保留缺失生命周期证据；不能用 SKU 或简单删除历史任务来凑平数量。
findings.evidence: 全部所选订单行／FO 行按稳定 ID 对应；父级未发现缺失引用。

findings.title: 核对风险建议的形成与处理时序
findings.fact: 固定批次 US 169 笔建议 CANCEL，其中 125 笔当前展示已履约；UK 也有 1 笔对应记录。
findings.interpretation: CANCEL 是建议；没有建议形成、人工决定和发货时序，不能认定已欺诈或商家明知放行。
findings.remedy: 取得对应风险评估时间、人工复核理由、支付授权、实际交付及争议材料，核对当前自动化和复核流程。
findings.acceptance: 有逐单可追溯的风险决策链；规则调整基于实际业务结果，不根据当前状态倒推历史动机。
findings.evidence: 新全量创建批次；并未用旧 169 数量作为复用结论。

findings.title: 统一 US 隐私政策的广告分享表述
findings.fact: 同一隐私政策否认sale/sharing及跨情境广告，同时描述跨商家/网站个性化广告；opt-out页也描述广告分享。
findings.interpretation: 已证的是公开表述冲突；实际广告分享、州法适用、Enhanced Services启用与真实数据流未验证，不据此认定非法出售。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 以实际数据流与州法适用评估统一隐私政策/choices页，准确区分服务商处理与广告分享，并验证适用选择机制。
findings.acceptance: 版本化公开文本无相互冲突；实际接收方、用途、法律角色和设置有证据对应；选择机制另有适用地区的行为验证。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://www.garvee.com/pages/data-sharing-opt-out、https://www.garvee.com/policies/privacy-policy

findings.title: 先核实增强服务，再补对应披露
findings.fact: 两站条款未见Shopify托管/处理披露；UK隐私页未见Shopify消费者隐私链接/Enhanced Services说明，US隐私页则有此类文字和链接。
findings.interpretation: 9.2.5 scope明确为Enhanced_Services；当前新preflight没有建立配置适用性。US政策自述使用enhanced features属于商家公开声明，不等于已验证配置。UK缺文字不能先判违约。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 先核对实际Enhanced Services与数据流；若适用则同时修订条款及隐私政策、必要的Shopify链接与选择入口。
findings.acceptance: 具体服务及地区前提有记录；适用时公开披露满足9.2.5各子条件，实际链接和选择机制分别验证。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/pages/privacy-policy、https://garvee.co.uk/pages/terms-of-service、https://www.garvee.com/policies/privacy-policy、https://www.garvee.com/policies/terms-of-service

findings.title: 补齐 UK 已审联系面缺少的电话信息
findings.fact: 已审UK联系页、contact policy、条款、隐私、配送及退货内容未提供商家联系电话；表单Phone Number是客户输入框。
findings.interpretation: 这是所审公开面的缺项，未穷尽整个Help Center/其他渠道；不宣称全网不存在电话。实体真实性、号码有效性和实际回复未检验。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 核实商家有效电话并在主要公开联系信息中清楚提供；核对法人/营业地址、联系方式与实体记录。
findings.acceptance: 匿名联系页明确列出商家电话、名称、地址和邮箱；实体/运营记录支持其准确，号码连通另验。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/pages/contact-us

findings.title: 明确法人、卖方与不同地址的用途
findings.fact: US公开contact列美国总部及多地办公室，后台contact policy/条款列另一深圳地址；UK公开自述ASSAM INDUSTRIAL LTD、英国注册地址，与shopAddress.countryCodeV2=US不是同一语义字段。
findings.interpretation: 不同办公室/联系地址可同时真实；UK法人、商户网点国家、注册地点、收单地点均未由域名、货币、时区或Shop地址独立证明。未查询公司登记/收单合约。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 收集当前主体/交易卖方/收单角色证明，标明各地址用途，同步前台与checkout政策；若后台字段不准确由主代理单独处理。
findings.acceptance: 公开交易主体、联系地址及实际网点/收单记录可追溯；允许有依据的多地地址，不能只机械统一国家。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/pages/contact-us、https://garvee.co.uk/pages/privacy-policy、https://www.garvee.com/pages/contact

findings.title: 澄清 US 配送时长及费用适用
findings.fact: 配送页前部给卡车运输7–10工作日，延迟退货条款引用10–15工作日并列20% restocking fee；退款页另保留酌情restocking表述。
findings.interpretation: 明确存在两种truck时长引用与不同费用表述；未证明实际迟发、收费错误或违法，也未检查最终结账是否补充说明。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 区分处理、运输、迟延判定及例外，统一可核对的时长/费用规则，说明适用范围并在购买前可见。
findings.acceptance: 同一运输场景的各页面承诺可一致解释；费用金额/依据及触发条件明确，实际样本另验。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://www.garvee.com/policies/refund-policy、https://www.garvee.com/policies/shipping-policy

findings.title: 澄清 US 卖方及售后责任
findings.fact: US条款把平台描述为交易第三方且商品不是平台售出，退款/配送页却以Garvee承担售后及交付。
findings.interpretation: 仅确认公开交易角色描述不清；实际seller of record、charge授权和合同法律效力未验证。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 按真实业务明确交易卖方、平台/关联公司角色和售后责任，避免用平台免责模板掩盖实际卖方义务。
findings.acceptance: 条款、订单/付款凭证、售后承诺与真实实体角色一致；实际授权/履约责任另有证明。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://www.garvee.com/policies/refund-policy、https://www.garvee.com/policies/terms-of-service

findings.title: 核对 UK 退货例外的法定权利边界
findings.fact: UK退货页明确30日收货起算、曼彻斯特退货地址、费用承担、检查与退款时间；同时把Final Sale/Clearance排除并将30日后故障导向维修/更换。
findings.interpretation: UK政策自述消费者法，不证明其例外/法定权利处理正确；EEA专条不可仅因UK域名套用。本轮不作无原始法条核验的最终违法判定。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 区分额外商业30日保证与不可排除的适用消费者权利，核对Final Sale、未使用/包装及故障补救表述。
findings.acceptance: 有适用消费者法审阅及明确保留法定权利的政策；实际取消/退款案例另验。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/pages/refund-return-policy

findings.title: 保留最终付款路径的未检范围
findings.fact: 每站只读一个商品购买面板及空购物车；未进入带商品最终付款流程。
findings.interpretation: 发货来源/国家选择器不是已证商家网点国家；政策端点可访问不是付款处可见/主动确认。一个商品样本不能外推全量。没有加购、购买、表单/同意提交。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 在另行授权的非交易测试路径或商家提供的可复核会话证据中核对金额附近网点国家、最终付款前政策披露和确认、商品特定警示。
findings.acceptance: 目标支付方式/市场实际最终付款前视图、当时政策版本、适用确认和主体国家位置可追溯；不提交真实订单。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/cart、https://garvee.co.uk/products/garvee-16-d-x-30-w-pho-358c8xar、https://www.garvee.com/cart、https://www.garvee.com/products/garvee-livestock-fence-4ft-x-328ft-pls-33cccehh

findings.title: 改善 UK 退货政策的直接可见性
findings.fact: UK已审首页/商品/购物车页脚无直接退货政策链接；条款正文Return Policy可到达已取退货页。
findings.interpretation: 不能说UK没有退货政策或无法匿名访问；目前是通过条款间接可达。易访问与最终购买路径可见性需分别核对。 未证实是 Catalog 拒绝原因。
findings.remedy: 建议在售后/页脚与关键购买路径给明确退货入口；保留现有条款链接。
findings.acceptance: 匿名顾客可直接找到现行退货政策，购买前入口可见；无需以新增入口推断整体法律已遵守。
findings.evidence: 已审公开页面与具体条件逐项核对，平台政策副本的对象标识仅保留在本地；https://garvee.co.uk/cart、https://garvee.co.uk/pages/refund-return-policy、https://garvee.co.uk/pages/terms-of-service

findings.title: 要求明确内部待办与复核路径
findings.fact: 目前只能确认 US 综合拒绝类别；账户安全、商家账单、内部案件、第三方网关风险和具体触发项未全部可见。
findings.interpretation: 无法从现有公开文档或近似 API 字段重建内部判定；未知应保留为未知。
findings.remedy: 在后台核对邮箱／两步验证、核验提示、账单和政策待办；向 Shopify 询问具体未满足项、材料要求和正式复核路径。支持请求草稿已准备，未发送。
findings.acceptance: 取得明确待办及完成证据；最终以 Agentic → Sources 的实际资格变化或 Shopify 明确回复验收，不承诺固定获批时间。
findings.evidence: 用户截图／确认、新权限预检及官方可观测性研究。

child_rules.condition: 订单多履约单汇总受组合影响：hold+未履约显示 Unfulfilled，hold+已履约显示 On hold，hold+已履约+未履约显示 Partially fulfilled；不能从订单徽标推断每单状态。

verification.method: 读取全部 fulfillment ID 对应状态。

child_rules.source_heading: Calculating shipping rates from different shipping profiles > Combined rates when only one location can fulfill the order {#combined-rates-when-only-one-location-can-fulfill-the-order}
child_rules.condition: 有可用单一地点时由 fulfillment priority 选；同组多个地点的 flat rate 只收一次，weight/carrier/app 仍组合。

child_rules.source_heading: Understanding shipping options by market > Combined rates at checkout {#how-rates-apply}
child_rules.condition: 仅 flat/order amount 可在一个 option 中有多 rate；同 option 取最高，不同 options 相加；preorders 与即时发货 rates 即使同 option 也相加。

child_rules.source_heading: Setting up order fulfillment for locations
child_rules.condition: 单地点库存可满足整单时可优先该地点；不能时可能分单或最高优先地点超卖；routing/profile 设置改变实际 origins。

child_rules.source_heading: Understanding order routing > Order routing rules
child_rules.condition: 默认依次 minimize split、stay within destination market、closest；规则顺序影响 origins，closest 按直线非行车距离。

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Compare observed time with fulfillAt/fulfillBy and inspect holds.

child_rules.source_heading: FulfillmentOrder > The lifecycle of a fulfillment order > The lifecycle of a fulfillment order at a merchant managed location
child_rules.condition: FO documentation says physical-order fulfillment can be created after picking/packing but before courier collection. Zero remainingQuantity or fulfillment SUCCESS therefore does not prove dispatch or delivery. Report outstanding-to-fulfill, carrier pickup/in-transit and delivered as distinct measures; missing tracking is unknown. TrackingInfo is an array whose first argument truncates it; existence of a tracking number alone does not prove pickup. Fulfillment.events is a cursor connection, whereas deliveredAt/inTransitAt are nullable event timestamps and estimatedDeliveryAt is only an estimate.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Separate creation/success from carrier pickup and delivery evidence.

child_rules.condition: Shopify automatically creates fulfillment orders after a background routing worker determines responsible locations; one or more FOs are created and assigned once routing completes. FOs cannot be manually created. There can be multiple FOs for one order even at the same location. Do not interpret immediate absence as zero demand or group/deduplicate solely by order+location. Distinguish routing pending, inaccessible and genuinely no qualifying current work; the documentation gives no fixed routing-latency guarantee.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Check interpretation of empty FO rows against routing lifecycle, visibility and observation timestamps; retain distinct FO IDs at the same location.

child_rules.evidence_limit: Exact cached 2026-04 creation/identity paragraphs; runtime routing state and latency are unobserved. No fixed completion SLA established.

child_rules.condition: For each Order LineItem ID at observation time, sum remainingQuantity over unique current, non-superseded FOLineItems requiring physical shipping. Unknown identity, quantity, visibility, or current-allocation status => unresolved/unknown, not zero.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Group current unique physical FOLI.remainingQuantity by Order LineItem and lifecycle bucket; inspect completeness.

Sorting/reverse/pagination do not change scope or prove complete history; preserve effective search/time/location filters.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Check connection completion, timestamps, filters, errors and consistency.

child_rules.condition: Order.displayFulfillmentStatus is a display aggregate, not FO workflow or shipment status. The full 2026-04 OrderDisplayFulfillmentStatus list is FULFILLED, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, OPEN, PARTIALLY_FULFILLED, PENDING_FULFILLMENT, REQUEST_DECLINED, RESTOCKED, SCHEDULED, UNFULFILLED. It contains no NOT_REQUIRED / Fulfillment not required member. Do not inject current Help labels as 2026-04 API enum values. Current Help wording is parent-reported here, not independently fetched. orders(query:) has its own search-token vocabulary: fulfillment_status accepts unshipped, shipped, fulfilled, partial, scheduled, on_hold, unfulfilled and request_declined in this body; order status accepts open, closed, cancelled and not_closed. These are search strings, not a license to insert matching tokens into FO status/request enums. Order status, order display fulfillment, FO status and shipment status stay distinct.

child_rules.condition: Keep requestStatus distinct from FO.status and Order display status. UNSUBMITTED is the only valid request status for non-service FOs; SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED and cancellation request/accept/reject states govern service coordination. requestStatus=CLOSED means the service closed without completing the work; cancellation requested alone is not proof work stopped. In the service-managed lifecycle the service accepts or rejects a submitted request; once accepted, the merchant/OMS must submit a cancellation request rather than simply cancelling the request. The service creates fulfillments and can add tracking later. Merchant-managed work instead completes by creating fulfillments; digital provisioning and physical packing/collection are different events. RejectFulfillmentRequest.lineItems documents which items were unfulfillable; after rejection none of the request's lines can be fulfilled, even if a subset of rejection reasons is supplied. Acceptance estimatedShippedAt is an estimate, not evidence of carrier pickup.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Compare requestStatus, FO.status and display status as separate fields.

child_rules.condition: OPEN=ready; SCHEDULED=deferred to fulfill_at; ON_HOLD=cannot initiate before release; IN_PROGRESS=processing; INCOMPLETE=cannot complete as requested. Preserve positive remaining quantities in all these buckets. CANCELLED/CLOSED allocations are not automatically current work: trace cancellation, move/merge and replacement lineage before excluding originals or declaring the order satisfied. fulfillmentOrderOpen applies to scheduled work and, since 2026-01 (thus in this 2026-04 source), can reopen progress-reported work at merchant-managed locations. ReportProgress applies to OPEN or IN_PROGRESS FOs; it does not prove shipment.

verification.procedure: Compare status filters with the cached seven-member FO enum.

child_rules.condition: fulfillmentOrderCancel documents a replacement FO for work left to do while closing the original. Counting both overcounts; dropping the original without seeing/reconciling the replacement undercounts. Requests awaiting cancellation acceptance can still complete work. Missing replacement under incomplete visibility is unknown. The cancellation description literally calls SUBMITTED and CANCELLATION_REQUESTED a "status". Those tokens belong to FulfillmentOrderRequestStatus and are absent from FulfillmentOrderStatus. Preserve this wording caveat and interpret coordination through requestStatus; never add those tokens to FO.status enum.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Find replacement/current allocation and account for pending cancellation completion.

child_rules.condition: fulfillmentOrderClose marks accepted, service-assigned IN_PROGRESS work incomplete and closes the fulfillment request. Control returns to merchant for moving, removing/refunding or requesting again. Do not infer FO.status=CLOSED, no residual demand, or shipment completion solely from the mutation name. Only the fulfillment-service app that accepted the request can call close for that accepted, service-assigned IN_PROGRESS FO; its id argument and payload explicitly describe marking incomplete.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Inspect FO status, request status and remainingQuantity independently.

child_rules.condition: A FO may have multiple holds; do not collapse to a single boolean or assume releasing one clears every hold. Preserve hold id, handle, reason and heldByRequestingApp. hold inputs can target particular FO lines; blank targets apply to all lines, while targeting lines on an already held FO is unsupported. Diagnose current holds, not merely the last action. Each app can have at most 10 active holds per FO. Handle is unique within the same app+FO and at most 64 characters; its default empty string permits only one same-handle hold in that namespace. notifyMerchant defaults false. Hold payload.fulfillmentHold=null means no hold was created; partial holds return a remainingFulfillmentOrder for unheld lines. ReleaseHold.holdIds apply only to the specified FO; if omitted, ALL its holds are released. Do not interpret an unspecified release as releasing only the requesting app's hold.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Enumerate all hold identities/reasons/ownership and any partial line targeting.

child_rules.source_heading: fulfillmentOrderMove > How re-assigning line items affects fulfillment orders
child_rules.condition: A full move can change location while retaining the original FO ID. Partial/previously fulfilled scenarios can create new FOs; existing target-location active work can be closed/recreated. Already fulfilled lines stay at the original location. movedFulfillmentOrder and originalFulfillmentOrder are role labels, not guaranteed distinct IDs. remainingFulfillmentOrder is deprecated. Re-enumerate current rows after transitions; never concatenate pre/post states into the same quantity total. Omitting fulfillmentOrderMove.fulfillmentOrderLineItems moves all UNFULFILLED lines, not all historically ordered or fulfilled units.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Compare current IDs/location/quantities and original/moved role IDs against lineage.

child_rules.condition: Move cannot change assignment while requestStatus is SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, CANCELLATION_REQUESTED or CANCELLATION_REJECTED without service cancellation acceptance. Closed work, reported progress, missing destination stock or permissions can also prevent a move. These constraints prevent simultaneous fulfillment by multiple locations/services.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Check request state, progress, closed status, destination stock and stated permissions.

child_rules.condition: Submitting a partial fulfillment request splits the original FO into submitted and remaining unsubmitted work. Re-read current Order.fulfillmentOrders and line IDs after the event; retain submitted and unsubmitted buckets, not the old full allocation plus new allocations. Omitting the submit-request line list requests all FO lines. submittedFulfillmentOrder normally equals the original but can differ for partial requests or requests on cancelled/incomplete FOs; unsubmittedFulfillmentOrder is only present for partial requests. notifyCustomer controls notification when later fulfillments are created, not proof of notification or shipment at request submission.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Inspect submitted/unsubmitted successor allocation IDs.

child_rules.condition: FulfillmentLineItem.lineItem maps fulfilled units back to Order LineItem; its quantity describes that fulfillment row. Keep Fulfillment.id/status/displayStatus and line IDs. Do not add fulfilled quantities to remaining quantities as outstanding demand, and do not count cancelled/failed fulfillment attempts as independent successful physical shipments. FulfillmentLineItem.quantity is nullable Int; null means unknown, never zero. Fulfillment.totalQuantity is the sum of fulfillment line quantities, not an additional quantity to add to those lines. Fulfillment.requiresShipping means ANY fulfillment line requires shipping, not that every line is physical. Preserve nullable displayStatus/deliveredAt/inTransitAt/estimatedDeliveryAt independently; an estimate is not an actual delivery event. FulfillmentStatus.OPEN and PENDING are deprecated, and SUCCESS is not proof of carrier delivery.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Join FulfillmentLineItem.lineItem and retain fulfillment/line IDs plus status.

child_rules.condition: RefundLineItem.lineItem joins the original Order LineItem and quantity is the refunded quantity; restockType describes restocking treatment. Refund records are financial/restocking evidence, not an extra subtraction from currentQuantity or proof of physical collection/delivery. Reconcile refund lineage without double subtraction. RefundLineItem.restocked is not applicable in SuggestedRefund context: a suggestion does not prove restocking. Its location is the inventory restock location, not shipment origin/destination evidence. RefundLineItem.id is nullable; do not merge multiple null IDs as one stable record. Refund.processedAt is not a substitute for successful transaction status or physical shipment evidence.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Join RefundLineItem.lineItem and examine quantity/restockType separately.

child_rules.condition: assignedFulfillmentOrders is restricted to app-owned service locations and excludes CLOSED by default; assignmentStatus can further filter requests. It is not an all-order historical FO source. fulfillmentOrders is scope-filtered even though described as all. Record query/filter choice before interpreting absence or totals. The GLOBAL fulfillmentOrders query also defaults includeClosed:false. Use includeClosed:true when historical closed lineage is required and still respect access scopes; this differs from Order.fulfillmentOrders(displayable:false). assignedFulfillmentOrders.locationIds further restricts locations; record that filter and assignmentStatus. A global or assigned filtered connection is not an unfiltered ledger.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Record assignedFulfillmentOrders ownership, CLOSED exclusion and assignmentStatus.

child_rules.condition: FulfillmentOrderLineItemInput.id is a FOLineItem ID, not Order LineItem ID; quantity is that FO line quantity. FulfillmentOrderLineItemsInput separately identifies fulfillmentOrderId. Omitting fulfillmentOrderLineItems means all FO lines, not zero; partial operations need explicit line quantities. fulfillmentCreateV2 is deprecated in this version in favor of fulfillmentCreate. Fulfillment creation combines FOs only for the same Order and Location. FulfillmentOrderLineItemsInput.fulfillmentOrderLineItems accepts at most 512 line items; this is an operation-input limit, not a catalog-size or SKU threshold. fulfillmentCreate and V2 require one of their listed write-fulfillment scopes plus fulfill_and_ship_orders; neither a declared action nor an omitted line array implies zero work.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Check FOLineItem IDs versus Order LineItem IDs and explicit/omitted line arrays.

child_rules.condition: Split moves specified lines/quantities into a new FO and can create a replacement when the original state cannot be split. Merge combines sets based on line-item inputs/quantities. Preserve source/result lineage and sum only the current unique allocations per Order LineItem; input/result roles do not establish distinct physical demand. Rescheduling can also merge FOs when fulfillAt datetimes match. The reschedule payload can return the merged result rather than the original FO. Reconcile identity after rescheduling as well as explicit split/merge operations.

verification.method: read_only_contract_check
verification.procedure: Inspect input/result line IDs/quantities and re-enumerate current membership.

child_rules.source_heading: 5.8.11.1 Finance Charges and Failure to Perform

coverage.title: 来源研究
coverage.detail: 入口 62 项保留精确原文位置；递归按新增相关依赖终止，无固定深度。四项新发现 Visa 依赖另补审，父级核对 132 处新证据无不一致。公开版次、责任主体和地区前提分别保留。

coverage.title: 订单与权限
coverage.detail: 两站实际 API 2026-04；已有 read_all_orders 等范围。固定创建批次共 89,149 笔唯一订单；US 1 条内部周边界重复内容一致，按 ID 去重。字段权限被拒、null、空记录分别保留。

coverage.title: 履约与物流
coverage.detail: 完整读取所选 10,905 笔订单的订单行、履约任务与数量等证据，父级逐文件哈希和行关联复核。物流事件仅补查明确子集，未把全量工作字段读取称为全量送达审核；订单当前标记不是历史不可变快照。

coverage.title: 公开披露
coverage.detail: 归档 43 个页面表示，42 取得、1 阻塞；每站一个商品购买面板及空购物车。74 个公开子检查逐站登记。公开文字、实体真实性、合同实际签订和经营遵守分别判断。

coverage.title: 商品结构与语义范围
coverage.detail: US 57,632、UK 7,597 个商品的主要字段、可读隐藏标记、全部观察到的变体和商品级发布连接已读取，图片存在性覆盖全商品。US 595 个商品 updatedAt 在区间内变化，未认证同一时点快照；UK 17 个变动商品定向复读，仅观察到 6 个变体的时间／库存变化。全文候选筛查不等于内容全审；UK 图片样本 7 个、文本上下文 20 个，US 商品分支图片／URL语义样本未执行。

limitations: 两站不是受控实验。UK 合格不能证明每项法律或运营要求通过，差异也不能直接识别 US 被拒的因果份额。
订单创建时间、读取时状态、争议发起时间和退款交易时间是不同口径；未把当前记录当成历史截止时点快照。
官方未公开 Catalog 的最低订单量、最低站龄、统一积压天数、拒付数值门槛或复评 SLA；没有自行补造。
Shop、Google、支付机构及卡组织项目的规定按各自产品、地区、角色和事件前提适用，不自动成为 Catalog 条件。
后台 taxonomy、Catalog 推断分类、外部渠道类别和支付 MCC 是不同字段；缺少实际 MCC 时未凭域名或货币推定。
商品正常排除不等于整店被拒；无反馈、无争议可见记录、空支付账户及应用权限不足不分别等于全店健康或失败。
最终带商品付款流程未测试；隐私选择实际行为、全面内部案件、第三方争议和实际交付仍需相应记录补证。
未修改店铺、开通权限、发送支持请求或对外消息；具体整改需以真实业务和适用合同为依据。
